correctness.rationale: A legal inverse deletion is exactly a repeated-symbol position. Two deletions yield the same parent exactly when the deleted positions lie in one constant run. This proves the pointwise formula. A run-length budget proves the maximum, and independent summation of run boundaries and singleton first runs proves the edge formula. Finite exhaustive replay independently checks the channel implementation and boundary cases.
